shortDescription: Resource module for Sites Wireless Settings Ssids

options.name: aaaOverride
options.description: Activate the AAA Override feature when set to true.

options.name: acctServers
options.description: List of Accounting server IpAddresses.

options.name: aclName
options.description: Pre-Auth Access Control List (ACL) Name.

options.name: authServer
options.description: For Guest SSIDs ('wlanType' is 'Guest' and 'l3AuthType' is 'web_auth'), the Authentication Server('authServer') is mandatory. Otherwise, it defaults to 'auth_external'.

options.name: authServers
options.description: List of Authentication/Authorization server IpAddresses.

options.name: authType
options.description: L2 Authentication Type (If authType is not open , then atleast one RSN Cipher Suite and corresponding valid AKM must be enabled). Default is L2 Authentication Type if exists else None.

options.name: basicServiceSetClientIdleTimeout
options.description: This refers to the duration of inactivity, measured in seconds, before a client connected to the Basic Service Set is considered idle and timed out. Default is Basic ServiceSet ClientIdle Timeout if exists else 300. If it needs to be disabled , pass 0 as its value else valid range is 15 to 100000.

options.name: basicServiceSetMaxIdleEnable
options.description: Activate the maximum idle feature for the Basic Service Set.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: cckmTsfTolerance
options.description: He default value is the Cckm Timestamp Tolerance (in milliseconds, if specified); otherwise, it is 0.

options.name: clientExclusionEnable
options.description: Activate the feature that allows for the exclusion of clients.

options.name: clientExclusionTimeout
options.description: This refers to the length of time, in seconds, a client is excluded or blocked from accessing the network after a specified number of unsuccessful attempts. Default is Client Exclusion Timeout if exists else 180.

options.name: clientRateLimit
options.description: This pertains to the maximum data transfer rate, specified in bits per second, that a client is permitted to achieve. It should be in mutliples of 500. Default is Client Rate Limit if exists else 0.

options.name: coverageHoleDetectionEnable
options.description: Activate Coverage Hole Detection feature when set to true.

options.name: directedMulticastServiceEnable
options.description: The Directed Multicast Service feature becomes operational when it is set to true.

options.name: egressQos
options.description: Egress QOS.

options.name: externalAuthIpAddress
options.description: External WebAuth URL (Mandatory for Guest SSIDs with wlanType = Guest, l3AuthType = web_auth and authServer = auth_external).

options.name: fastTransition
options.description: Fast Transition.

options.name: fastTransitionOverTheDistributedSystemEnable
options.description: Enable Fast Transition over the Distributed System when set to true.

options.name: ghz24Policy
options.description: 2.4 Ghz Band Policy value. Allowed only when 2.4 Radio Band is enabled in ssidRadioType.

options.name: ghz6PolicyClientSteering
options.description: true if 6 GHz Policy Client Steering is enabled, else False.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. SSID ID.

options.name: ingressQos
options.description: Ingress QOS.

options.name: isApBeaconProtectionEnabled
options.description: When set to true, the Access Point (AP) Beacon Protection feature is activated, enhancing the security of the network.

options.name: isAuthKey8021x
options.description: When set to true, the 802.1X authentication key is in use.

options.name: isAuthKey8021xPlusFT
options.description: When set to true, the 802.1X-Plus-FT authentication key is in use.

options.name: isAuthKey8021x_SHA256
options.description: When set to true, the feature that enables 802.1X authentication using the SHA256 algorithm is turned on.

options.name: isAuthKeyEasyPSK
options.description: When set to true, the feature that enables the use of Easy Pre-shared Key (PSK) authentication is activated.

options.name: isAuthKeyOWE
options.description: When set to true, the Opportunistic Wireless Encryption (OWE) authentication key feature is turned on.

options.name: isAuthKeyPSK
options.description: When set to true, the Pre-shared Key (PSK) authentication feature is enabled.

options.name: isAuthKeyPSKPlusFT
options.description: When set to true, the feature that enables the combination of Pre-shared Key (PSK) and Fast Transition (FT) authentication keys is activated.

options.name: isAuthKeyPSKSHA256
options.description: The feature that allows the use of Pre-shared Key (PSK) authentication with the SHA256 algorithm is enabled when it is set to true.

options.name: isAuthKeySae
options.description: When set to true, the feature enabling the Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) authentication key is activated.

options.name: isAuthKeySaeExt
options.description: When set to true, the Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) Extended Authentication key feature is turned on.

options.name: isAuthKeySaeExtPlusFT
options.description: When set to true, the Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) combined with Fast Transition (FT) Authentication Key feature is enabled.

options.name: isAuthKeySaePlusFT
options.description: Activating this setting by switching it to true turns on the authentication key feature that supports both Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) and Fast Transition (FT).

options.name: isAuthKeySuiteB1921x
options.description: When set to true, the SuiteB192-1x authentication key feature is enabled.

options.name: isAuthKeySuiteB1x
options.description: When activated by setting it to true, the SuiteB-1x authentication key feature is engaged.

options.name: isBroadcastSSID
options.description: When activated by setting it to true, the Broadcast SSID feature will make the SSID publicly visible to wireless devices searching for available networks.

options.name: isCckmEnabled
options.description: true if CCKM is enabled, else False.

options.name: isEnabled
options.description: Set SSID's admin status as 'Enabled' when set to true.

options.name: isFastLaneEnabled
options.description: true if FastLane is enabled, else False.

options.name: isHex
options.description: true if passphrase is in Hex format, else False.

options.name: isMacFilteringEnabled
options.description: When set to true, MAC Filtering will be activated, allowing control over network access based on the MAC address of the device.

options.name: isPosturingEnabled
options.description: Applicable only for Enterprise SSIDs. When set to True, Posturing will enabled. Required to be set to True if ACL needs to be mapped for Enterprise SSID.

options.name: isRadiusProfilingEnabled
options.description: 'true' if Radius profiling needs to be enabled, defaults to 'false' if not specified. At least one AAA/PSN server is required to enable Radius Profiling.

options.name: isRandomMacFilterEnabled
options.description: Deny clients using randomized MAC addresses when set to true.

options.name: l3AuthType
options.description: L3 Authentication Type. When 'wlanType' is 'Enterprise', 'l3AuthType' is optional and defaults to 'open' if not specified. If 'wlanType' is 'Guest' then 'l3AuthType' is mandatory.

options.name: managementFrameProtectionClientprotection
options.description: Default is Management Frame Protection Client if exists else Optional.

options.name: multiPSKSettings
options.description: Sites Wireless Settings Ssids's multiPSKSettings.

options.name: nasOptions
options.description: Pre-Defined NAS Options AP ETH Mac Address, AP IP address, AP Location , AP MAC Address, AP Name, AP Policy Tag, AP Site Tag, SSID, System IP Address, System MAC Address, System Name.

options.name: neighborListEnable
options.description: The Neighbor List feature is enabled when it is set to true.

options.name: openSsid
options.description: Open SSID which is already created in the design and not associated to any other OPEN-SECURED SSID.

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Passphrase (Only applicable for SSID with PERSONAL security level). Passphrase needs to be between 8 and 63 characters for ASCII type. HEX passphrase needs to be 64 characters.

options.name: policyProfileName
options.description: Policy Profile Name. If 'policyProfileName' is not provided, the value of 'profileName' will be assigned to it. If 'profileName' is also not provided, an autogenerated name will be used. Autogenerated name is generated by appending 'ssid' field's value with '_profile' (Example If 'ssid' = 'ExampleSsid', then autogenerated name will be 'ExampleSsid_profile').

options.name: profileName
options.description: WLAN Profile Name, if not passed autogenerated profile name will be assigned.

options.name: protectedManagementFrame
options.description: (REQUIRED is applicable for authType WPA3_PERSONAL, WPA3_ENTERPRISE, OPEN_SECURED) and (OPTIONAL/REQUIRED is applicable for authType WPA2_WPA3_PERSONAL and WPA2_WPA3_ENTERPRISE).

options.name: removeOverrideInHierarchy
options.description: RemoveOverrideInHierarchy query parameter. Remove override in hierarchy. Refer Feature tab for details.

options.name: rsnCipherSuiteCcmp128
options.description: When set to true, the Robust Security Network (RSN) Cipher Suite CCMP128 encryption protocol is activated.

options.name: rsnCipherSuiteCcmp256
options.description: When set to true, the Robust Security Network (RSN) Cipher Suite CCMP256 encryption protocol is activated.

options.name: rsnCipherSuiteGcmp128
options.description: When set to true, the Robust Security Network (RSN) Cipher Suite GCMP128 encryption protocol is activated.

options.name: rsnCipherSuiteGcmp256
options.description: When set to true, the Robust Security Network (RSN) Cipher Suite GCMP256 encryption protocol is activated.

options.name: sessionTimeOut
options.description: This denotes the allotted time span, expressed in seconds, before a session is automatically terminated due to inactivity. Default sessionTimeOut is 1800.

options.name: sessionTimeOutEnable
options.description: Turn on the feature that imposes a time limit on user sessions.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId path parameter. Site UUID of Global site.

options.name: sleepingClientEnable
options.description: When set to true, this will activate the timeout settings that apply to clients in sleep mode.

options.name: sleepingClientTimeout
options.description: This refers to the amount of time, measured in minutes, before a sleeping (inactive) client is timed out of the network. Default is Sleeping Client Timeout if exists else 720.

options.name: ssid
options.description: Name of the SSID.

options.name: ssidRadioType
options.description: Radio Policy Enum (default Triple band operation(2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz)).

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: webPassthrough
options.description: When set to true, the Web-Passthrough feature will be activated for the Guest SSID, allowing guests to bypass certain login requirements.

options.name: wlanBandSelectEnable
options.description: Band select is allowed only when band options selected contains at least 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz band else false.

options.name: wlanType
options.description: Wlan Type.
